from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CaseRecord(BaseModel):
    """A single judgment document record extracted for classification."""
    title: str = Field(description="The title or identifier of the judgment document (e.g., '判决文书 1')")
    stated_cause_of_action: str = Field(description="The cause of action or case category explicitly stated in the document text")
    case_nature: str = Field(description="The broad nature of the case: 'Administrative', 'Civil', 'Criminal', 'Execution'")
    key_subject: str = Field(description="The core legal subject matter (e.g., 'Land Rights', 'Labor Relation', 'Product Liability')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    case_records: list[CaseRecord]
